title: betula × intermedia nothosubsp. seideliana
intro: Betula × intermedia nothosubsp. seideliana, commonly known as silver birch, is a hybrid plant resulting from the cross between Betula pendula and Betula pubescens, two species of the Betula genus. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat a variety of health issues, including fever, inflammation, and skin problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Betula × intermedia nothosubsp. seideliana include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, making it effective in soothing and protecting the skin. The bioactive constituents of this plant include salicin, a compound similar to aspirin, as well as flavonoids and polyphenols, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
